title: server.ts
description: Opens the SQLite database (`DB`, in memory by default) and the library over it with `openLibrary`, which subscribes the policies' event handlers and runs the outbox's relay once, so events left undelivered are delivered; then serves the router on `127.0.0.1` at `PORT` (default 5310), with the library's time zone from `TIME_ZONE` (default `America/New_York`). An unknown time zone stops it at start-up with a message. It is also the library's daily clock: it runs the event handler TL-LEND-PO02-H at start and every 24 hours, with a reminder sender that writes each reminder to the log, since the example has no mail server. Stops cleanly, clock and all, on SIGINT or SIGTERM.
